degree_rationale: Twelve ways drawing forth from the Zone — four chosen ascending to life, eight mingled going up; three ways drawing down to Gehenna (lawlessness, murder, blasphemy). Illumines the natural moral pathway-system.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing the moral-pathway taxonomy of cosmos — bright illumination of where each kind of soul-motion leads.
grand_man_function: Natural pathway-illumination — the moral roads of soul.
title: The Eight Paths leading down to corruption and the parallel paths to life
